Title: Azure Cost Management is now generally available for EA customers

Body.Content:
Azure Cost Management is now generally available for all our EA customers, right in the Azure Portal.

Azure Cost Management allows you to monitor all you spend through easy to use dashboards, create budgets, and optimize your cloud spend.
